voiceWidget.initialChatMsg: Hello, I am NARA, your emotional companion. How are you feeling right now, and how can I support you?
voiceWidget.inputPlaceholder: Type a message or speak with NARA...
voiceWidget.greetingPill: 🎙️ Talk by voice with NARA without having to type
voiceWidget.greetingSpeech: Hello sweetheart... I'm Nara, your friend and safe haven. You don't have to pretend everything is okay here or be strong all the time. How are you really feeling today? Tell me, I'm listening with all my heart.

replies.chemoHard: Oh my dear, come here and let me hold you close. I'm so sorry you're having such a tough day during chemotherapy. You don't have to push yourself or pretend to be okay; just breathe gently with me. Your only job today is to rest. Would you like us to take a slow one-minute breathing pause together to ease your body?
replies.scared: Hello sweetheart, I'm right here with you... I'm Nara, your friend. I hear you and I won't let go of your hand. It's so completely normal to feel afraid or want to cry today; you don't have to carry this alone. Tell me: what stage of your journey are you in right now, newly diagnosed or in treatment?
replies.chemoTired: I'm holding your hand tight, friend. I know how deeply chemo drains both body and spirit. Give yourself permission to rest without any guilt today, and try taking tiny sips of ice-cold water with mint or ginger. I'll stay right here talking softly with you. Shall we do a gentle breathing exercise together?
replies.breathe: Let's do it together, dear. Gently close your eyes... Take a deep breath in through your nose, feeling calm in your chest... one, two, three, four... Hold it gently... and let it out slowly, releasing the weight from your shoulders. You are doing wonderfully. I am right here with you.
replies.diagnosis: I know that receiving a diagnosis shakes your entire world. Let's take it one single day at a time, without rushing. I'm here to explain each step with warmth, free from cold medical jargon.
replies.family: Supporting someone you love also requires tenderness with yourself. Sometimes the greatest support is simply holding their hand in quiet warmth without expecting anyone to stay strong.
replies.default: I'm listening with all my heart, friend. You don't have to type when you feel exhausted; just talk to me anytime and I'll walk beside you step by step. How is your body feeling right now?

hero.description: Comprehensive emotional, clinical, and practical support to guide you through diagnosis, active treatment, and breast cancer recovery together with your family, partner, and friends in a warm haven.

glassCard.title: Where are you joining us from today?
glassCard.subtitle: Choose your path to access tailored tools, video workshops, nutrition plans, and compassionate guides:

patient.title: I am a Patient
patient.desc: Step-by-step guidance from day one, emotional grounding, specialized nutrition, and checklists for every doctor visit.

caregiver.title: I am a Family Member or Caregiver
caregiver.desc: Learn to support without burning out, what to say in difficult moments, guidance for children, and self-care protocols.

journey.title: Where are you in your journey today?
journey.subtitle: Each stage brings unique questions and needs. Select your current phase to access timely and compassionate clinical recommendations.

stage1.pill: Step 1 · Breathe, you are not alone
stage1.title: I have just been diagnosed
stage1.desc: The initial impact brings uncertainty and medical information overload. Your priority today is not to have all the answers, but to organize essential questions, quiet the fear, and allow yourself to rest without guilt.
stage1.card1Desc: To take directly to your second oncology visit.
stage1.tipQuote: "Bring a trusted friend or family member to appointments solely to take notes for you."

stage2.title: In Chemotherapy or Radiation
stage2.desc: Concrete tools to relieve side effects, protect sensitive skin, adapt your meals to altered taste buds, and protect your peace of mind between infusion cycles.
stage2.card1Desc: Nourishing clean calories, warm purees, and gentle hydration.
stage2.card2Desc: Radiodermatitis prevention and gentle skin barrier relief.
stage2.tipQuote: "Using wooden or bamboo utensils helps prevent the metallic taste while eating."

stage3.title: Surgery, Mastectomy & Reconstruction
stage3.desc: Learn safe mobility exercises to prevent lymphedema, surgical drain post-op care, and intimate emotional support to reconnect with your body.
stage3.card1Desc: Safe mobility routines for arms and chest.
stage3.card2Desc: Narrative therapy to honor your healing scars.
stage3.tipQuote: "Early guided rehabilitation prevents up to 80% of upper body mobility complications."

stage4.title: Life After Treatment & Remission
stage4.desc: Finishing treatment is not the end of emotional processing. Fear of recurrence or feeling unanchored when returning to routine is normal. Here we address scanxiety and redesigning life priorities.
stage4.card2Desc: Cardiovascular protection, bone strength, and restorative sleep.
stage4.tipQuote: "Remission is also an invitation to learn how to live without rushing."

pillars.title: The 4 Pillars of Love Heals Care
pillars.subtitle: We support more than your medical chart: we care for your plate, your emotions, your body, and the loved ones who stand by you at home.

p1.title: Nutrition & Digestive Comfort
p1.desc: Gentle recipes for when nausea, fatigue, or low appetite peak. Hydration protocols and anti-inflammatory meals tailored to each treatment cycle.

p2.title: Library & Workbooks
p2.desc: Recommended survivor memoirs, the acclaimed 'Emotions Journal', and printable 'Essential Questions for Your Oncologist'.

p3.title: Video Workshops & Gentle Mobility
p3.desc: Restorative oncology yoga capsules, diaphragmatic breathwork for waiting room anxiety, and intimate video stories.

p4.title: Family, Partners & Children
p4.desc: Practical guide: 'What to say and what to avoid', tools to prevent primary caregiver burnout, and how to talk with children with tenderness and truth.

masterclasses.title: Oceanfront Healing: Guided Sessions
masterclasses.subtitle: Audiovisual capsules, clinical psycho-oncology, and gentle movement filmed in the natural serene oceanfront. Watch at your own pace whenever you need peace.

featured.title: Healing with Aloha: Compassionate Conversations
featured.speaker: With Dr. Alana Ka'uhane · Psycho-Oncology Specialist
featured.desc: An intimate and comforting session on embracing vulnerability after a difficult diagnosis, calming nighttime racing thoughts, and communicating serenely with family.

c1.title: Gentle Oncology Chair Yoga by the Sea
c1.desc: Adapted stretches for neck, shoulders, and chest guided with soothing ocean breeze.

c2.title: Ocean Waves & Inner Peace Meditation
c2.desc: Real Pacific ocean wave acoustics to dissolve physical anxiety before medical scans.

c3.title: Cellular Nutrition & Soothing Smoothies
c3.desc: Live demonstration of fresh hydrating smoothies and soothing broths for infusion days.

circles.title: Safe & Confidential Virtual Support Circles
circles.subtitle: Small group gatherings of up to 10 women, gently moderated by oncology psychologists. No judgment, only deep mutual understanding.

testimonial.quote: "The day I was diagnosed, I felt like I was falling into a bottomless abyss. Finding Love Heals and joining their first virtual circle was the first time in weeks I could cry and tell my truth without having to put on a brave face for my kids. They saved my spirit."
testimonial.name: Lorena Morales G.
